info.name: AML API OAuth Assets Transaction Analyses API

items.docs: Given a subject, customer and analysis type, perform the requested analysis and return the result

params.name: expand
params.description:
comma-separated list of child nested objects to expand in the response,
e.g. `?expand=contributions`

params.name: tx_time_before
params.description: filter out all customer transactions whose tx_time is <= the provided value (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: tx_time_after
params.description: filter out all customer transactions whose tx_time is >= the provided value (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: has_triggered_rule
params.description: filter by transactions based on whether they've triggered any rules

params.name: min_risk_score
params.description: minimum risk score

params.name: max_risk_score
params.description: maximum risk score

params.name: min_risk_score_change
params.description: minimum risk score change since last screening

params.name: max_risk_score_change
params.description: maximum risk score change since last screening

params.name: min_value
params.description: minimum value of the asset in it's minor unit (satoshis, wei etc)

params.name: max_value
params.description: minimum value of the asset in it's minor unit (satoshis, wei etc)

params.name: min_value_usd
params.description: minimum USD value

params.name: max_value_usd
params.description: maximum USD value

params.name: analysed_at_before
params.description: only return analysis that has been analysed before the given time (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: analysed_at_after
params.description: only return analysis that has been analysed after the given time (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: customer_reference
params.description: only return analysis whose customer reference matches the given string

params.name: customer_reference_contains
params.description: only return analysis whose customer reference contains the given string

params.name: workflow_status
params.description: only return analyses whose workflow status matches any of the given values. Accepts a single value or an array of values.

params.name: hash
params.description: filter customer transactions whose hash is equal to the given one (case insensitive)

params.name: hash_contains
params.description: filter customer transactions whose hash contains the given string (case insensitive)

params.name: address_hash
params.description: filter customer transactions whose address is equal to the given one (case insensitive)

params.name: address_hash_contains
params.description: filter customer transactions whose address contains the given string (case insensitive)

params.name: id
params.description: get only transactions with given ids

params.name: coverage
params.description: return the transaction analyses for a certain coverage level

params.name: analysed_by
params.description: the ID of the actor who ran the query

params.name: customer_id
params.description: the ID of the customer this transaction is linked to

params.name: assigned_team_user_id
params.description: return transaction analyses that are assigned to the given team user ID(s). To get transaction analyses that are unassigned, include an empty string in your query. Multiple IDs can be provided as a comma-separated list.

params.name: process_status
params.description: return rows that are in any of the states specified in the array. Each element is one of (running, complete, error).

params.name: risk_rules
params.description: return transactions that has triggered at least one of the specified risk_rules. To get transactions that have not triggered any rules, include empty string in your query. e.g. "?risk_rules=,f7c36274-ba55-4f6b-8d46-d8cbe97d7c32"

params.name: type
params.description: get only deposit or withdrawal analyses

params.name: user_supplied_base58
params.description: if true, returns only transactions created by users that have provided a base58 (for BTC only). Otherwise, return those with provided output_indices.

params.name: asset
params.description: return only transaction that has been made on a particular asset or asset/blockchain combination

params.name: screening_source
params.description: Indicates whether the screening was done via the Synchronous endpoint, Asynchronous endpoint, as part of the Automatic Rescreening feature or as a fallback system rescreening in case of error

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by criterion

params.name: page
params.description: pagination page number

params.name: per_page
params.description: pagination per page number, has a maximum value of 500.

params.name: subject_type
params.description: get only transaction or address analyses

params.name: predictive
params.description: get only Predictive transactions. Predictive transactions were analyzed too close to the tip of the blockchain, so the full picture of associated addresses might be incomplete.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results that are counted. If more analyses than this number are present then this number is returned. This improves the performance of queries over large datasets

items.docs: Paginate through all analyses, with various sort/filter parameters.

Performs a batch of analyses (the max batch size is 100). Responses will contain IDs of the newly created analyses.

Returned analyses will be **processing**, you must use the IDs returned to lookup the results later via [GET analyses/:id](#operation/getAnalysisById)

params.name: mc_analysis_id
params.description: id of the analysis to retrieve

params.name: includeScreenings
params.description: toggle whether to include the screening history

params.name: previousScreenings
params.description: Number of previous screenings to include in the response

items.docs: Given an ID, return a single analysis

info.name: Get a screening of the analysis by ID

params.name: mc_analysis_id
params.description: id of the analysis to retrieve

params.name: screening_id
params.description: id of the screening to retrieve

items.docs: Given a screening ID, return the screening of the analysis
